_about: Image prompts per location, scene card and portrait, from docs/design/puzzles.md and the character sheets. Descriptions only: no film, studio, game or artist names. Queue with: python3 tools/art-pipeline/queue.py [ids...]

ch01_ny_room.prompt: first-person view of a hotel room in New York in 1867, on the left a writing desk covered with newspapers and a thick leather-bound book, in the middle a tall window onto an avenue with horse-drawn carriages and gas lamps, no cars, no automobiles, no modern buildings, on the right wooden crates of fossils and specimens, a door on the far right, warm oil-lamp light, no people

ch01_ny_quay.prompt: first-person view of the Brooklyn pier in 1867, on the left a large black steam frigate with two smoking funnels and tall masts moored at the quay, a wooden gangway in the middle, a crowd waving handkerchiefs on the right, grey morning sky, river water

ch02_deck.prompt: first-person view on the wooden deck of a 19th-century steam frigate at sea, a mast with rigging in the middle rising out of frame, the bow and bowsprit on the left with a coiled harpoon line, the bridge and a door on the right, the empty Pacific ocean under a hazy sky

ch02_wardroom.prompt: first-person view of a small ship's wardroom in 1867, a chart table in the middle with a large sea chart of the Pacific weighed down by instruments, an open logbook on the right, a swinging oil lamp above, wooden panelling, a doorway on the left

title.prompt: a long cigar-shaped 19th-century submarine gliding through deep blue water lit by shafts of light from the surface, a glowing lantern at its prow, fish around it, no text
